title: Lahore High Court Announces New Dress Code for Lawyers
excerpt: The Lahore High Court has instructed lawyers to wear gowns during court proceedings starting from November 2.
body_html:
The Lahore High Court has issued a directive regarding the dress code for legal professionals practicing in the court. According to the announcement, lawyers are required to resume wearing gowns during all court proceedings.

The new dress code instruction is scheduled to take effect starting from November 2.
